headline: ARI @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.43 at TBR 4.69, with a projected total of 9.13. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Barrosa, Victor Mesa Jr. because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
